apps.name: VSP
apps.subtitle: VNC + SSH client
apps.localizedDescription:
One window into every machine. SSH terminals, VNC desktops, keys and host fingerprints in one place.

Add a machine, flip on the protocols it speaks, and connect. SSH keys are generated on-device and deployed in a tap; machine secrets can sit behind a vault password.

versions.localizedDescription: First public build: SSH terminal + SFTP browser, pure-Dart VNC client, machine vault encryption.
